data.body:
**Landed.** Gerrit change 2350 merged to main as ae4f6c1a07a9666adfbd7882e06d11dade61966a (Change-Id I5ecbef2). Both gates green on patch set 3: **LLM-Review +1 (PASS)** AND **Verified +1 (CI success**, run 33219932728). PS1 had surfaced a Verified-1 (docs/mcp-reference.md is a GENERATED file — my sentence had been hand-appended; fixed by updating the generator scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py and regenerating). PS1/PS3 LLM-Review advisory test-coverage findings were closed by extending the held-out oracle (WorkflowValidationError/WorkflowVersionError→invalid_input; run-absent-from-ticket→not_found through the real get_workflow_status tool) — now 9 tests, all green.

Two residual PS3 advisory (non-blocking) findings, consciously accepted as cosmetic polish (change already merged with both gates green): (1) WorkflowNotFoundError is not re-exported from src/rebar/llm/workflow/__init__.py alongside its siblings; (2) the WorkflowNotFoundError source= message-prefix shape has no dedicated message-text assertion (by design the oracle asserts on the error CODE, not message text). Neither is a correctness gap. Proceeding to close with class=plan_defect, caused_by=8a31-e1c3-cf31-4239 (biomedical-upper-tench, commit 77f1c4011c83) — same class as the closed fixes wolflike-chevroned-haddock and dear-name-ladle.
